_about: Global deep-time events for the ticker. label <= 26 chars (fits 192 px). Ages are consensus values; 'source' names the reference to check against. Written 2026-10-02 from general knowledge -- spot-check before publishing.

events.label: AFTER THE GREAT DYING
events.note: End-Permian extinction: ~80% of marine species lost

events.label: CARNIAN PLUVIAL EPISODE
events.note: Wet pulse in a dry world; dinosaurs diversify after it
events.source: Dal Corso et al. 2020, Science Advances

events.label: END-TRIASSIC EXTINCTION
events.note: CAMP volcanism as Pangaea rifts; dinosaurs take over

events.label: ATLANTIC STARTS OPENING
events.note: Seafloor spreading begins in the central Atlantic

events.label: TYRANNOSAURUS REX
events.note: Hell Creek and Lance formations, 68-66 Ma
events.source: Hell Creek dating, Sprain et al. 2015

events.label: DECCAN TRAPS ERUPT
events.note: Flood basalts in India begin before the impact

events.label: ASTEROID IMPACT
events.source: Schulte et al. 2010, Science; Renne et al. 2013

events.label: PALEOCENE HEATWAVE
events.note: PETM: +5-8 °C in a few thousand years
